races.name: Julie Satterley Waving Goodbye To 49 Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Ja Klipdrift
runners_data.note: Lightly raced newcomer with unknown running style returning after a break, making assessment difficult
runners_data.comment: Third foal from a German Flat winner; probably best watched on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 4,000euros yearling; third foal; dam German 7f/1m winner, sister to useful 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Jan Maat, half-sister to 7f Listed winner Japan; probably best watched on debut.

runners_data.name: La Fille Friday
runners_data.note: Another lightly raced debutant from Tom Gretton's stable which is struggling at 0/4 in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Best watched on this racecourse debut.
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam unraced half-sister to useful 2m hurdle winner Aristo Du Plessis, out of maiden sister to French 2m1f chase winner Babati; best watched on this racecourse debut.

runners_data.name: Machete Beach
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with proven class who returns fresh after 25-day break and suits the likely strong pace
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who scored twice on Flat over 1m2f in 2024 for Harry Charlton; returned from a 359-day break to open his account over hurdles in a weak Hereford maiden (2m, good) 25 days ago; has clearly had issues but possesses plenty of talent and should go close.

runners_data.name: Maskarvel
runners_data.note: Front-runner with consistent hurdles form but trainer has no winners from 12 runners in last fortnight
runners_data.comment: Three encouraging runs over hurdles, most recently when second at Aintree 15 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Made the frame in all three Irish bumpers last year and launched hurdling career with three very encouraging runs for new stable, most recently when clear second at Aintree (2m1f, good) 15 days ago; looks sure to run well.

runners_data.name: Usyk
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter returning from a lengthy 267-day absence which raises fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Showed clear promise in bumpers last year; hurdles debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed clear promise when making the frame in a couple of bumpers last summer, but below that form when sixth of seven in a similar event at Worcester (2m, good; favourite) in September; makes hurdling debut and market will be best guide to his chance.

runners_data.name: At Sunrise
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner but modest form suggests he lacks the class to capitalize on his pace style
runners_data.comment: Has shown just modest form in a couple of bumpers and two hurdle starts; easy to dismiss.
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown just modest form in a couple of bumpers and two hurdle starts; easy to dismiss.

runners_data.name: Take The Boat
runners_data.note: Hold-up type switching from flat racing with useful speed who should benefit from the expected strong gallop
runners_data.comment: Four wins on AW Flat over 7f-1m4f at a modest level; hurdles debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins on AW Flat over 7f-1m4f at a modest level; interesting how she takes to this new discipline; may be one to fight out minor honours.

races.paceDynamic: Usyk, Maskarvel, and At Sunrise will all want the lead, creating a strong gallop from the start over this stamina-testing 2m2½f trip. The three confirmed front-runners will ensure a genuine pace that should suit those who can settle and finish, particularly on good to firm ground that will quicken the tempo further. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses like Machete Beach and Take The Boat who can capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse, while the speed horses will likely burn each other out in a sustained battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prosper
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too hard early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for Machete Beach and Take The Boat to close late when the leaders tire. Machete Beach's proven class and recent winning form gives him the edge over Take The Boat who brings useful flat speed to the discipline.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Battle
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate terms and see off rivals
scenarios.body: Maskarvel's consistent form and hurdles experience could allow him to control the tempo better than Usyk or At Sunrise. His clear second last time out suggests he has the class to make all or win from the front.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go impossibly fast and tie up badly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl in the final furlong with any horse with energy left able to win. The lightly raced newcomers Ja Klipdrift and La Fille Friday could benefit from their freshness if they can stay in touch.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters moderate early but maintain strong tempo
scenarios.body: The race becomes a true test of stamina with only the most genuine stayers lasting home. At Sunrise's modest form suggests he cannot sustain the required pace, leaving Maskarvel as the most likely survivor.

watchPoints.text: Usyk's fitness after 267 days off could see him fold quickly despite his front-running style
Tom Gretton's stable form is poor at 0/4 in 14 days, affecting both debutants Ja Klipdrift and La Fille Friday
Machete Beach's 25-day freshening break could have him perfectly primed for this stamina test
The three confirmed front-runners could engage in a pace duel that destroys all their chances
Take The Boat's switch from flat to hurdles brings unknown jumping ability despite her useful speed credentials

races.name: Happy 70th Birthday Rich Wilding Mares' Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Stellarmasterpiece
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid recent form but needs strong pace to be effective, carries Sean Bowen booking and returns from lengthy 129-day break
runners_data.comment: Has won five times on the Flat but best run over hurdles was when third at Doncaster.
runners_data.spotlight: Has won once on the Flat in Poland and four times at Catterick (1m4f), but the best she has been able to muster in seven runs over hurdles is when third of nine finishers at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) in November; interesting that Sean Bowen rides for the first time.

runners_data.name: Kottayam
runners_data.note: Inconsistent hold-up type switching to Dave Roberts yard with modest recent efforts but has shown glimpses of ability when placed
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise when placed a couple of times last year for Patrick Neville but pulled up in a couple of handicaps for Dylan Cunha and last of ten to complete on stable debut at Ludlow (2m5f, good) last month after six-month break; drops back in trip and tongue-tie is back on along with first-time cheekpieces; major revival required.

runners_data.name: Little Lady Lucy
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner fresh from Wincanton success who relishes shorter trips, Bradley Harris retains the ride after recent wins
runners_data.comment: Got off the mark in this sphere at Wincanton last month; followed up at Taunton since.
runners_data.spotlight: Relished the drop in trip and front-running tactics when getting off the mark in this sphere at Wincanton (1m7f, good; 25-1) last month; showed that was no fluke when following up at Taunton (2m, good) ten days later; 8lb higher here but this track should play to her strengths and looks the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Noble Miss
runners_data.note: Struggling hold-up performer trying first-time blinkers after poor recent form, returning from 106-day layoff under inexperienced rider
runners_data.comment: Won a bumper for Rae Guest but has no form claims on what she's achieved over hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: Won a bumper for Rae Guest but has no form claims on what she's achieved over hurdles, including three handicaps at Fakenham; first-time blinkers are now applied along with hood.

runners_data.name: Blue Siam
runners_data.note: Young hold-up type with time on her side, swapping hood for cheekpieces and showing minor promise in limited hurdles experience
runners_data.comment: Modest Flat maiden and only minor promise in her three races over hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: Modest Flat maiden and only minor promise in her three races over hurdles; she still has time on her side, though, and she swaps a hood for cheekpieces on her handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Liasse d'Argent
runners_data.note: Modest form over hurdles trying first-time tongue-tie on handicap debut, needs significant improvement for new connections
runners_data.comment: Has shown just modest form so far; sports first-time tongue-tie on handicap debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown just modest form so far; sports first-time tongue-tie on handicap debut and improvement required.

runners_data.name: Burgeon
runners_data.note: Poor recent form including Warwick pull-up, trying tongue-tie and cheekpieces combination after disappointing in four hurdle starts
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown little in four hurdle starts, including on handicap debut when pulled up at Warwick (2m5f, good) 26 days ago; sports first-time tongue-tie and cheekpieces, and they need to have an impact.

runners_data.name: For Love Of Beauty
runners_data.note: Weak handicap form with no obvious claims, returning from 51-day break with disappointing Taunton effort last time out
runners_data.comment: Has shown only poor form in four runs over hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown only poor form in four runs over hurdles, including when fifth of six finishers at Taunton (2m, good) last month on her handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Little Lady Lucy appears the most likely pace-setter given her recent front-running success at Wincanton, with Kottayam potentially offering some early company despite her hold-up classification. The sustained pace should be manageable rather than searching, as there's limited genuine early speed in this field. With most runners carrying hold-up styles and needing to be produced late, the race will likely develop into a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial in the straight. This shape favours horses who can travel prominently and have the pace to quicken when it matters, disadvantaging pure hold-up horses who rely on strong gallops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Travellers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Little Lady Lucy sets steady fractions and prominent runners can track her easily
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows horses like Stellarmasterpiece and Little Lady Lucy to save energy for a decisive move, while pure hold-up types get caught flat-footed when the tempo lifts approaching the final flight. Those who positioned themselves within striking distance can capitalise on their superior tactical position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong or Little Lady Lucy goes too fast
scenarios.body: The searching gallop sets up perfectly for closers who can produce sustained finishes, with front-runners paying for their early exertions. Hold-up horses like Stellarmasterpiece and Kottayam benefit from the pace collapse to deliver their trademark late charges.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Little Lady Lucy dominates from the front with no serious challenges
scenarios.body: Her proven front-running ability and recent Wincanton success translates perfectly as she controls fractions throughout and kicks clear approaching the last. The lack of genuine pace pressure allows her to dictate terms completely, with hold-up horses unable to bridge the gap she creates in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses commit early trying to track Little Lady Lucy or challenge for the lead
scenarios.body: The unexpectedly strong gallop leaves most runners struggling in the final furlong, creating opportunities for unconsidered outsiders with fresh legs. Horses who settled furthest back and avoided the early battles can pick up the pieces as others tie up.

watchPoints.text: Little Lady Lucy's early pace-setting will be crucial - if she goes too fast she'll set it up for closers despite her recent front-running success
Stellarmasterpiece needs a strong gallop to be effective but returns from a 129-day break which could blunt her finishing kick
Noble Miss sports first-time blinkers after poor form but Jamie Gambin's 7lb claim may not be enough to compensate for her struggles
Kottayam's form has been inconsistent and she's switching yards to Dave Roberts with limited recent runners, making her reliability questionable
Blue Siam and Burgeon both have new headgear arrangements which could signal connections expect improved performances

races.name: Julie Satterley 50th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: In The Air
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who may have needed his Chepstow reappearance after 49 days off and faces strong pace competition from three other forward-going types.
runners_data.comment: Won five over hurdles, and three over fences last term for current trainer.
runners_data.spotlight: Won five over hurdles for previous yards and three over fences last term for current trainer; may have needed the run when seventh of eight finishers at Chepstow (2m, good to soft) last month after six-month layoff but probably needs to come down the weights.

runners_data.name: Forget The Way
runners_data.note: Sharp prominent style suits this trip and showed solid form when second at Warwick 10 days ago, giving him a fitness edge over most rivals.
runners_data.comment: Has three wins in this sphere and was runner-up at Warwick ten days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Has three wins in this sphere and made a solid return when runner-up at Warwick (2m, good) ten days ago following a six-month break; should be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Half A Chance
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making his handicap hurdles return after Irish pointing, totally reliant on Hope Rising maintaining a genuine gallop to close into.
runners_data.comment: Irish challenger whose sole success came at Limerick on his hurdles debut in May 2024.
runners_data.spotlight: Irish challenger whose sole success came in a Limerick maiden on his hurdles debut in May 2024; placed five times last term and returns to this discipline after a couple of unsuccessful runs over fences this month; win record is offputting.

runners_data.name: Hope Rising
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner whose three wins last season came over shorter trips, raising stamina questions over this extended distance at just five years old.
runners_data.comment: May not have got home when third at Huntingdon on her return to action 23 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Won three in her first season over hurdles last term and may not have got home when third of five at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) on her return to action 23 days ago; should be sharper for the run and holds claims.

runners_data.name: Juan Bermudez
runners_data.note: Course and distance specialist with three wins here who was beaten only a neck last time and gets handy 7lb claim from Lilly Pinchin.
runners_data.comment: All three wins over hurdles have been over C&D; must come into the reckoning.
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins over hurdles have been over C&D; returned to form when beaten a neck over C&D (good) last month and filled the same position at Aintree (2m1f, good) 15 days ago; is a major force around here and must come into the reckoning.

races.paceDynamic: Hope Rising will take this race on from the front with her confirmed leading style, setting what should be a manageable gallop over this extended 2m2½f trip. The prominent trio of In The Air, Forget The Way, and Juan Bermudez will track her closely but are unlikely to pressure the pace early given the small field size. Half A Chance as the sole hold-up horse will need Hope Rising to maintain a strong gallop to have something to aim at in the straight. This shape clearly favors the front-running and prominent horses who can control their own destiny rather than relying on pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hope Rising Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Hope Rising maintains a steady tempo without being pressured early
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions and has the class edge with three wins last season, while the lack of early pressure allows her to conserve energy for the finish. Her prominent rivals will struggle to peg back a horse who gets first run on them.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover Late
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio apply sustained pressure from the home turn
scenarios.body: Hope Rising may crack under the combined assault of three experienced handicappers tracking her every move. Juan Bermudez looks particularly dangerous given his three course and distance wins and recent neck defeat here.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Irish Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hope Rising sets genuine gallop and holds her kick to the straight
scenarios.body: Half A Chance gets the strong pace he needs to unleash his finishing kick despite the extended absence. The hold-up style becomes a major weapon when the pace collapses in front of him.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Hope Rising goes too slow and the field bunches approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where jockey claims and trainer form matter more than pure ability. This chaotic finish could throw up any result from the tight-knit field.

watchPoints.text: Hope Rising could get an uncontested lead if the prominent trio are too respectful early and allow her to dictate soft fractions
Juan Bermudez has home advantage with three course wins and Lilly Pinchin's 7lb claim makes him effectively the top-rated horse
Half A Chance needs Hope Rising to maintain strong gallop throughout as the sole closer in a pace-heavy field
Forget The Way has the fitness advantage with his recent Warwick run and Jonathan Burke's 11% strike rate for the James Owen yard
In The Air could outrun his odds if the Chepstow run has blown away the cobwebs from his 49-day break

races.name: Farmers Fresh Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Ivane
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning after 100 days off but has strong course form and Jonathan Burke's 5lb claim helps offset the lengthy absence
runners_data.comment: Successful over fences and hurdles last term but went off the boil on his last two runs.
runners_data.spotlight: Successful over fences (twice) and hurdles last term; went off the boil on his last two runs early on this year and is 7lb higher than his last winning mark; looks to need to come down the weights.

runners_data.name: Yes Day
runners_data.note: Needs the first-time blinkers to spark improvement as his form has been poor, but Jonjo O'Neill Jr knows him well and the 11lb drop in weights is significant
runners_data.comment: Both wins over fences came in March 2025 but his season never took off last term.
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins over fences came in March 2025; his season never took off last term and he arrives here on a career-low mark (11lb below last win); first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces; needs to show more.

runners_data.name: Imperial Alex
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner over this trip who shaped well when narrowly beaten last time and will appreciate the lack of pace pressure
runners_data.comment: Back to his best when beaten a neck at Ffos Las 25 days ago with 15l back to the third.
runners_data.spotlight: Four-times winning chaser over around 3m; returned to his best when beaten a neck at Ffos Las (3m, good) 25 days ago with 15l back to the third; nudged up 4lb but holds claims if he gets home over this marathon trip.

runners_data.name: Esperti
runners_data.note: In-form hold-up horse whose recent Ffos Las win suggests he's back to his best, with Sean Bowen's tactical awareness a major plus
runners_data.spotlight: Has returned to form of late and gained his fifth chase success, at Ffos Las (3m, good) last month; there was no disgrace in finishing second to a resurgent Tommy Beau at Fakenham (3m5f, good) this month and he holds strong claims while in this form.

runners_data.name: Ballynaheer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who bounced back to win last time but disappointed at Fontwell since, though Rian Corcoran's 5lb claim is valuable
runners_data.spotlight: Landed his fourth win over fences, at Market Rasen (3m, good) last month but below his best at Fontwell since; is the type to bounce back and he should get the trip (has won over 3m2f).

races.paceDynamic: Imperial Alex will set a modest gallop from the front with no other genuine pace-setters in this small field. Ballynaheer may track him closely given his prominent style, but the overall tempo will be sedate through the early stages. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint from the last mile, heavily favouring the hold-up horses who can produce late kicks. This shape strongly benefits Ivane, Yes Day, and Esperti who all prefer to come from off the pace in small-field tactical affairs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Alex sets his usual steady gallop without pressure from Ballynaheer
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl until the business end, perfectly suiting the three hold-up specialists who can time their challenges. Esperti and Ivane have the class to exploit this scenario with their proven finishing kicks over this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Imperial Alex Sustains Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Alex maintains his advantage and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: His recent neck defeat at Ffos Las proves his stamina over 3m, and without serious pace pressure he can dictate terms. Ballynaheer's prominent style could help him track the leader and benefit from the solid gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ballynaheer Forces Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the 7-year-old decides to press Imperial Alex early and create a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: This would stretch the field and potentially find out the stamina of some rivals over this extended trip. Esperti's recent form suggests he handles a true test best, while Yes Day might struggle with the sustained pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse of Favourites
scenarios.trigger: If both Esperti and Ivane fail to reproduce their recent form or encounter jumping issues
scenarios.body: Yes Day could sneak through despite his poor recent record, particularly with first-time blinkers sharpening his focus. Imperial Alex would benefit most from a diminished field given his front-running style.

watchPoints.text: Imperial Alex's jumping - any early mistakes could hand the initiative to Ballynaheer and change the entire complexion of the race
Yes Day's response to first-time blinkers in the early stages as poor headway could leave him with too much to do in a slowly-run race
Esperti's position turning for home as Sean Bowen needs to time his challenge perfectly if the pace is steady throughout
Ivane's fitness after 100 days off as any signs of rustiness could be costly in what may become a sprint finish
The pace through the first mile as anything faster than steady would significantly alter the finishing order

races.name: Owen Thomas Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: In This World
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose style perfectly suits the expected strong pace, though his recent form suggests he needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Showed his best form for his current yard when fifth at Warwick 26 days ago.
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice for the Skeltons; showed his best form for his current yard when fifth of eight at Warwick (2m, good) 26 days ago; his mark continues to drop and he should find another opening at some point.

runners_data.name: Delpotro
runners_data.note: Front-runner with class but stamina limitations at 2m1f, likely to set the pace but vulnerable if it becomes too fierce
runners_data.comment: Front-runner whose two wins last year came at Sedgefield when making all.
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner whose two wins last year came at Sedgefield when making all; his suspect stamina gave out in a match at Hereford (2m5f, good) 18 days ago but this track back down in trip should play to his strengths; regular hood returns after being omitted last time.

runners_data.name: Bobbarelli
runners_data.note: Another front-runner coming off disappointing fence debut, drops back in class but faces pace pressure from similar types
runners_data.comment: Disappointed when beaten 20l over fences at Bangor last Saturday.
runners_data.spotlight: A dual winning pointer, he was runner-up twice over hurdles this year but disappointed when beaten 20l over fences at Bangor (2m4f, good) last Saturday; drops back in trip and may be worth another chance.

runners_data.name: Turpin Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up hurdler making belated chase debut after 187-day break, style suits but the fencing debut is a major unknown
runners_data.comment: Four-times winning hurdler making a belated debut over fences after six-month break.
runners_data.spotlight: Four-times winning hurdler making a belated debut over fences after six-month break; hard to fancy unless there is a move in the market.

runners_data.name: Rocks Up Late
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from wind surgery and 193-day absence, has the form over fences but needs to prove his fitness
runners_data.comment: Four wins last spring/summer but was beaten 25l at Lingfield when last seen in November.
runners_data.spotlight: Won four times over fences last spring/summer but was beaten 25l at Lingfield (2m, good) when last seen in November; has had wind surgery since and is only 1lb higher than for his last success; must hold claims from good yard if ready to roll.

races.paceDynamic: Delpotro, Bobbarelli, and Rocks Up Late will set a fierce gallop from the start, with Delpotro likely to dictate from the front given his front-running style and stamina limitations at this trip. The sustained pace over 2m1f will test stamina reserves, particularly as three confirmed leaders battle for position early. In This World and Turpin Gold will need to pick up the pieces from behind as the pace collapses. This strong early gallop clearly favours hold-up horses who can conserve energy and finish strongly when the front-runners tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and compound each other's pace
scenarios.body: The sustained battle between Delpotro, Bobbarelli and Rocks Up Late will drain their stamina reserves over the final 4-5 furlongs. In This World can capitalise from his hold-up position to sweep past tired leaders approaching the last.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Delpotro Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Delpotro can dictate fractions and see off his pace rivals
scenarios.body: By establishing an early lead and managing the tempo better than his front-running rivals, Delpotro can maintain enough in reserve. His class advantage over this field shows when the others fold approaching the final fence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Rocks Up Late Returns Fresh
scenarios.trigger: If Rocks Up Late's wind surgery and 193-day break pays dividends
scenarios.body: The extended absence could have refreshed Rocks Up Late completely, allowing him to outbattle the other front-runners. His four wins over fences last season show his ability when right, and the wind operation addresses his main weakness.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Turpin Gold Debuts Successfully
scenarios.trigger: If Turpin Gold's chase debut benefits from his hurdles class
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old's four hurdle wins and fresh legs after 187 days could see him adapt quickly to fences. His hold-up style perfectly suits the expected pace collapse, though the debut over fences remains a significant unknown.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Delpotro gets an easy lead early as his class could tell if he avoids a pace battle
Monitor Turpin Gold's jumping on chase debut as any novicey errors will end his chances from the back
Check for market moves on Rocks Up Late as any significant support would suggest the wind surgery has worked
Watch how Bobbarelli settles early as his front-running style may force him into the pace battle
Observe In This World's position turning in as he needs the leaders to come back to him significantly

races.name: Happy 70th Birthday Steve Cotton Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Mix Of Clover
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 200-day break with poor trainer form (0/12) undermining his fitness despite previous course success.
runners_data.comment: Won here over fences last October; returns from a six-month break.
runners_data.spotlight: A summer jumper who mixes hurdling with chasing; won here over fences (2m5f, good) last October; returns from a six-month break and has never won following such an absence.

runners_data.name: Two To Tango
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent course win and only 37 days since last run, giving him clear fitness advantage in small field.
runners_data.comment: After being placed 12 times he gained an overdue success around here in March.
runners_data.spotlight: After being placed 12 times he gained an overdue success around here (2m3f, good) in March; let down by his jumping at Warwick since but looks sure to be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Gateau De Miel
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making stable debut for new trainer with course win last June but unclear current condition after hunter chase campaign.
runners_data.comment: Won over fences here last June; has been beaten in hunter chases/points since.
runners_data.spotlight: His second success over fences came at this track (2m6f, good) last June; has been beaten in hunter chases/points since and makes stable debut; may be better suited by 3m but not out of this.

runners_data.name: Boom Boom
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 192 days but has dual course victories over similar distances on good ground.
runners_data.comment: Won here over 2m1f and an extended 2m3f last summer; subsequently lost his form.
runners_data.spotlight: Won here over 2m1f (good) and an extended 2m3f (good to firm) last summer; subsequently lost his form in three runs; hard to gauge how he will run after a layoff but he would come into this if back on song.

runners_data.name: Lacrima
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been beaten by 64 lengths and 60 lengths in Britain despite removing blinkers, with concerning fade pattern.
runners_data.spotlight: Won four times when trained in France last year but has been beaten 64l and 60l on his two starts in Britain; steps up in trip and blinkers worn last time are left off; hard to fancy until he shows a bit of form.

races.paceDynamic: Lacrima will force the pace from the front with his prominent style, though his recent poor British form and tendency to fade in finishes suggests he won't sustain a strong gallop. Mix Of Clover may press from prominent position but returns from a 200-day break which undermines his early pace threat. The three hold-up horses (Two To Tango, Gateau De Miel, Boom Boom) will track behind what should be a moderate tempo. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up runners who can exploit Lacrima's expected capitulation and have time to organize their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lacrima sets modest fractions and fades as expected in the straight
scenarios.body: The three hold-up runners get perfect conditions to time their runs and sweep past the weakening pace-setter. Two To Tango and Gateau De Miel benefit most from having recent race fitness and proven form at this track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Lacrima and Mix Of Clover struggle with fitness/form issues early
scenarios.body: Boom Boom gets an uncontested lead through moderate fractions and holds on despite his own layoff concerns. His course form gives him the edge over the other hold-up runners in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mix Of Clover Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Mix Of Clover's class overcomes his 200-day absence and he stays prominent throughout
scenarios.body: The 12-year-old's experience allows him to judge the pace better than Lacrima and he outstays the hold-up horses. His summer jumping background suits these conditions despite the lengthy break.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lacrima Shocks
scenarios.trigger: If Lacrima's step up to 2m5f transforms his stamina and he removes blinkers
scenarios.body: The trip extension allows him to settle better and avoid his usual fade, catching the hold-up horses napping. This requires a complete reversal of his recent British form pattern.

watchPoints.text: Lacrima's early pace-setting - if he goes too slow the hold-up horses get perfect conditions to pounce
Mix Of Clover's jumping early on - his 200-day break could show in rusty technique over the first few fences
Two To Tango's position turning for home - needs to be handy to use his superior fitness advantage
Boom Boom's movement through the field - any signs of ring-rustiness will end his chances quickly
Gateau De Miel's response to pressure - stable debut runners often need the run regardless of ability

races.paceDynamic: American Trio, Miss Tiara, and Great d'Ange will ensure a strong early gallop over this extended 2m6f trip at Stratford. American Trio showed pace when winning his seller at Exeter and will want to use his early speed, while Miss Tiara has been stepping up in trip and naturally goes forward. The sustained tempo will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay the trip and finish strongly, particularly those proven over similar distances.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a genuine pace throughout
scenarios.body: The strong tempo will set up perfectly for patient hold-up performers with proven stamina. Late-running types like Lion Of The Desert and Tao Enki can pick off tired leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and tie up significantly
scenarios.body: American Trio or Miss Tiara could steal it if they get an easier lead than expected when rivals drop away. The pace-setters survive their own early exertions when others fail to sustain their challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Shesonnet can track the pace and time her challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: Her recent Warwick win suggests she's found her level and the prominent position allows her to avoid trouble. She can strike when the leaders weaken but before the hold-up horses fully wind up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is extreme and causes multiple fallers or mistakes
scenarios.body: A big-priced hold-up horse like Parikarma gets a dream scenario when better-fancied rivals make errors. The veteran can use her experience to avoid trouble and capitalize on others' misfortunes.

watchPoints.text: American Trio and Miss Tiara could set unsustainable fractions that compromise their finishing kicks and set up the closers perfectly
Tao Enki needs the first-time cheekpieces to have the same positive effect they showed at Hereford to be competitive
Great d'Ange may struggle to justify favoritism given his poor recent form for current connections
Shesonnet's 26-day break could blunt her edge despite her impressive Warwick victory last time out
Lion Of The Desert must prove his Ffos Las form translates to this stiffer track and stronger company
